text: Crew members are AI teammates that are always on. To add one, switch to Crew at the top left.
Then press plus, next to the crew member's name.
Start from a template, or from blank. Give them an icon, a name, and one line about what they're for.
A new crew member asks for a role and a purpose. Choose Set them up, and answer a few quick questions in chat.
Templates come with their own setup steps, so your new teammate knows exactly what to ask you.
